end.parentNote: Asha practised visualising square and triangular sequences with Ishita through dot pictures. Ishita used the growing row or column to find the next term and showed how two triangles fit together to make a rectangle; picture-based arguments were partly right but not steady yet. At home, ask Ishita to draw one new square or triangle pattern and explain why the next total changes as it does.
